title: Concept: Build-time environment injected into the page
description: A page that carries several build-time environment values in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Build-time values are shipped to every browser, so anything placed there is public; teams routinely put keys there that were meant for the server.
applicability: Deployments that render a page that carries several build-time environment values into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Build-time values are shipped to every browser, so anything placed there is public; teams routinely put keys there that were meant for the server.
